王野、王铁柱和赵爷爷刚走到门口，就看到何雨柱领着何雨水，见王野出来，何雨柱领着何雨水上前两步打招呼道：“赵爷爷，王叔，王野兄弟。”

王铁柱和赵爷爷点了点头，算是打过招呼了。王野开口询问：“柱子哥这是有事儿？”

“兄弟，昨天晚上的事儿你也知道，原来在院里，雨水自己我也没多管，可是现在，我觉得大院的婶子大娘都别有用心。我想白天上班的时候，让雨水在你们院里玩，你看行吗？”

“那有什么，我去跟我娘说一声。”说完就要转身进院。

何雨柱赶紧拦住王野说：“兄弟，那个哥哥还有个事儿。”何雨柱磕磕巴巴的。

王野说：“柱子哥，有事儿你就说！咱兄弟不用这样见外。”

“就是中午的时候，让婶子给雨水一口吃的，我们不白吃，我带着雨水的口粮呢！”说完从手里递给王野一个小口袋。王野也没有推辞，现在这个时代，就是亲兄弟走亲戚都要自带口粮。如果王野不接过来，何雨水真能中午饿一顿。

王野拿着袋子，带着何雨柱兄妹进入院子，王野把袋子递给秦婉，说了何雨柱的来意。

秦婉说：“以后就让雨水在我们院里玩就行了，放心吧！我们院子小，没那么多人，也那么多事儿，柱子就放心吧！”

“谢谢婶子！”事情说完，王野和何雨柱就去上班了。

一路说说笑笑，很快到了工厂，王野跟同事一样到了办公室。进屋和众人打了声招呼，沏茶回座位拿起了一张报纸，王野可不会看报纸，他用报纸往脸上一盖，开始睡回笼觉。

睡了没一会儿，王野就不舒服了，这坐着睡觉太难受了，脖子疼，腰疼，腿麻。王野站起来跺了跺脚。拿起搪瓷缸子喝了一大口，看见屋里就孙叔一个人了，就问：“孙叔，大力哥他们呢？”

“出去转转，闲着也是闲着。”

“那孙叔，我也出去溜达溜达，眯了一会儿腿都麻了。”

“去吧去吧！”

王野也不知道去干嘛，就在厂里瞎溜达，走着走着就到了三食堂。王野闲着也是闲着，想着去看看何雨柱。从后门走进食堂，看见食堂中忙的热火朝天。只有何雨柱一个人坐着，拿着一个大缸子喝着水。

王野一进门就喊：“柱子哥，干啥呢？”

何雨柱放下缸子，说：“王野兄弟，你怎么来食堂了，是饿了吗？要不哥哥先给你找点吃的？”

“柱子哥，这才刚吃了早饭，我又不是饭桶，哪能这么早就饿了呀。”

“那你是有事儿？”

“没事儿，在办公室闲的屁股都疼了，出来溜达溜达。”

何雨柱感慨的说：“还是兄弟你们的工作好呀！不像我们，一天天的累的半死。”

“柱子哥，你也累呀，我刚才进来可见你歇着呢。”

“你是光见贼吃肉，没见贼挨打啊！就那大锅菜，都是你柱哥炒的，那大铲子跟个铁锹一样，一干就是一中午。那汗滴答滴答的。”

王野一脸嫌弃的说：“柱子哥你炒菜滴答汗呀？”

As soon as Wang Ye, Wang Tiezhu and Grandpa Zhao walked to the door, they saw He Yuzhu leading He Yueyue. Seeing Wang Ye coming out, He Yuzhu took He Yuzhu and took two steps forward to say hello: "Grandpa Zhao, Uncle Wang, Brother Wang Ye."

Wang Tiezhu and Grandpa Zhao nodded, which was regarded as saying hello.Wang Ye asked: "Brother Zhuzhu, is something wrong?"

"Brother, you also know what happened last night. It turns out that I didn't care about Rainwater in the courtyard. But now, I feel that the aunts and ladies in the courtyard have ulterior motives. I want to let Rainwater play in your courtyard when I go to work during the day. Do you think that's okay?"

"What's the matter? I'll go tell my mother." After saying that, he turned around and entered the hospital.

He Yuzhu quickly stopped Wang Ye and said, "Brother, that brother has something to do." He Yuzhu stumbled.

Wang Ye said: "Brother Zhuzi, just tell me if you have anything to do! We brothers don't have to be exposed like this."

"At noon, I asked my aunt to give Yu Yu a bite to eat. We don't eat for free. I'm bringing Yu Yu's rations!" After saying that, he handed Wang Ye a small bag from his hand.Wang Ye didn't refuse. In this day and age, even brothers visiting relatives have to bring their own food rations.If Wang Ye didn't take it over, He Yuyu would really be hungry at noon.

Wang Ye took the bag and took He Yuzhu's brother and sister into the yard. Wang Ye handed the bag to Qin Wan and told He Yuzhu's purpose.

Qin Wan said: "From now on, just let the rainwater play in our yard, don't worry! Our yard is small, there are not so many people, and there are so many things, so Zhuzi, don't worry!"

"Thank you, Auntie!" After finishing the matter, Wang Ye and He Yuzhu went to work.

Talking and laughing all the way, we soon arrived at the factory. Wang Ye arrived at the office like his colleagues.He entered the room and said hello to everyone, made tea, returned to his seat and picked up a newspaper. Wang Ye didn't know how to read a newspaper. He covered his face with the newspaper and began to fall asleep.

After sleeping for a while, Wang Ye felt uncomfortable. It was too uncomfortable to sleep sitting up. His neck hurt, his waist hurt, and his legs were numb.Wang Ye stood up and stamped his feet.He picked up the enamel jar and took a long sip. Seeing that Uncle Sun was the only one in the room, he asked, "Uncle Sun, where are Brother Dali and the others?"

"Go out and walk around. Being idle is also idle."

"Uncle Sun, I went out for a walk too. My legs were numb after squinting for a while."

"Go, go, go!"

Wang Ye didn't know what he was going for, so he just wandered around the factory and arrived at the third canteen.Wang Ye was also idle, thinking about going to see He Yuzhu.Walking into the canteen from the back door, I saw that the canteen was very busy.Only He Yuzhu was sitting alone, drinking water from a large vat.

As soon as Wang Ye entered the door, he shouted: "Brother Zhuzhu, what are you doing?"

He Yuzhu put down the jar and said, "Brother Wang Ye, why are you in the cafeteria? Are you hungry? Why don't you find me something to eat first?"

"Brother Zhuzhu, I just had breakfast. I'm not a good eater. How can I be hungry so early?"

"Then something is wrong with you?"

"It's okay. My butt hurts from being idle in the office. Let's go out for a walk."

He Yuzhu said with emotion: "Brothers, your work is better! Unlike us, we are almost exhausted every day."

"Brother Zhuzi, you are tired too. I came in just now and saw that you were resting."

"You only saw the thieves eating meat, but you didn't see the thieves being beaten! That big pot of food was cooked by your brother Zhu. The big shovel was like a shovel. It lasted all afternoon. It was dripping with sweat."

Wang Ye said with a look of disgust: "Brother Zhuzi, are you sweating while cooking?"
